text:
alec: Heads-up — we need to bring SurgeFlow-8B into the platform this week. Primary asks: quant INT8 smoke, ctx-sweep to 8k, and baseline latency/throughput. tagging @maria @sam for prioritization.

maria: On it. Can we target Dedicated pool for final validation, but do a Hosted quick pass first?

sam: Prefer Hosted first for quick perf data. I'll run an int8 smoke on the fast queue (low-run overhead).

jo: Adding to boarding board now. What's the priority?

alec: P1 for onboarding if customer POC depends on this — otherwise P2. Also add QC + regression evals to checklist.

bench-bot: Queued: bench/surgeflow-8b/int8-smoke on queue 'fast' — run id 20260320-01 :gear:

alec: Perf command for smoke: ```./bench --model surgeflow-8b --quant int8 --bs 1 --ctx 2048 --iters 100``` Also run bs 8 and 16 for throughput measurements.

maria: FYI we saw memory spikes last week during another int8 attempt — add `--kv-cache-limit 4G` flag if you hit OOMs.

sam: quick numbers from hosted int8 smoke (w/kv-cache-limit 4G): p99 latency ~48ms @bs1, stable throughput ~220 tok/s @bs16. No 8k ctx sweep yet.

jo: Please add the following evals to the intake: instruction-following canonical set + 50-prompt regression set used for previous 8b brings.

alec: Quality check note: compare int8 -> fp16 on 100 random seeds, require diff threshold <=0.02 on perplexity and >=95% pass on S0 metrics.

bench-bot: Run complete: benchmarks/20260320-01 — results uploaded to s3://redwood-bench/surgeflow8b/20260320-01.json

maria: Quick look: latency looks healthy but hallucination score regressed on config A (top-k=40). Tagging @leo for QC.

leo: I'll run the full eval harness tonight and try toggling per-channel quant and qint4 fallback ablation.

sam: If QC fails, fallback plan: route Hosted traffic to SurgeFlow-4B on canary (5%) and put dedicated rollback policy in place. Add smart-routing rule: prefer dedicated when model_quality < threshold.

alec: Action items: 1) Maria — ctx-sweep [2k,4k,8k] by EOD and upload heatmap. 2) Sam — throughput heatmap across bs [1,2,4,8,16]. 3) Jo — create canary rollout plan + PR for routing policy. 4) Leo — full regression eval + ablation. Sync tomorrow 10:00am PT. :thumbsup:

jo: Noted. I'll kick off the board card and add links to run outputs.

maria: Kicking ctx-sweep now, will post partial results to thread as they come.

bench-bot: New run queued: benchmarks/20260320-02 (ctx-sweep) — estimated completion 3h.

alec: Thanks everyone — lean on bench infra if you need faster queues. Ping me if anything blocks the canary prep.
